newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares march on, market seen bullish.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares march on, market seen bullish.

text.p: Zimbabwean stocks surged ahead on Thursday, posting further gains on some heavily sought counters pushing the main industrial index to a new record high.

The 57-counter industrial index jumped 75.51 points to close the day at 6,749.70 as the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange continued a month-long bull run that has partly been fuelled by prospects of falling interest rates and some positive corporate results.

The industrial pointer was driven higher on Thursday by gains in Zimbabwe Newspapers which traded 50 cents up at 1,300 and Zimbabwe Sun Hotels (Zimsun) group and Plate Glass Industries (PGI), which rose 30 cents each to 400 and 510 respectively.
"There is no let-up. The market remains generally bullish, with considerable buying pressure on some (industrial) shares," one broker said.
The secondary seven-share mining index climbed 6.61 points to 1,409.69 following 20 and 50-cent gains in coal miners Wankie at 350 and nickel producer Bindura at 1,200.
